page.overview:
Who is Nesune Bihara?

Nesune is a slender and birdlike Kandori with dark hair and nearly black eyes.

She is strong in the One Power with a strength of . In the group of Aes Sedai that arrived in Far Madding, only Cadsuane Melaidhrin and Merise Haindehl stand higher. Among the thirty-nine Aes Sedai sent by Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan to kidnap Rand al'Thor, only Galina Casban and Sashalle Anderly are higher and Katerine Alruddin is her equal.

According to Egwene al'Vere, Nesune has an exceptional eidetic memory: she can cast a look on a page and then read it aloud, and remember conversations word by word that took place years ago. She can tell if the attention of a student wanders, even if her back is to the class. She is a naturalist, and likes to collect specimens.

Nesune is 174 years old. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in . After spending five years as novice and four as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .
